lead: Halle Berry is best known as an American television actor, born on 14 August 1966 in Cleveland.
As of 2026, she is 60 years old, and her birth date places her under the Leo sign.

She is associated with work such as Monster's Ball, X-Men and John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum and has been recognised with Academy Award for Best Actress and National Board of Review Award for Best Actress.
The sections that follow break down Halle Berry's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Halle Berry — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Halle Berry was born on 14 August 1966 in Cleveland, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Maria Halle Berry at birth and is publicly known as Halle Berry.
Public records name her father, Jerome Jesse Berry and her mother, Judith Ann Hawkins.
She studied at Bedford High School and Cuyahoga Community College.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Halle Berry — Career and Professional Work
paras: Halle Berry works primarily as a television actor, film actor, model, television producer, beauty pageant contestant and voice actor.
Among the credits most often linked to Halle are Monster's Ball, X-Men and John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum.

sections.heading: Halle Berry — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She has been married to David Justice (married 1993, until 1997), Eric Benét (married 2001, until 2005) and Olivier Martinez (married 2013, until 2016).
She is a parent to Maceo Martinez.
She is associated with Los Angeles and Oakwood as a place of residence.

sections.heading: Halle Berry — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Halle Berry circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where her income is likely to originate: professional work as a television actor, film actor, model, television producer, beauty pageant contestant and voice actor, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and project fees and royalties from credited work.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
